prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2][反例] 行标题长于数据 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "考核指标" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 278px
  col 2: header "权重" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 36px
  col 3: header "目标值" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "实际值" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 54px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 458px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 457px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各项绩效考核指标的权重，并比较目标值与实际值。","reading":"读者先按左侧指标定位行，再横向查看权重、目标值和实际值；也会纵向浏览各项权重和目标完成情况。","groups":["目标值与实际值是一组需要逐行比较的数据，宽度和视觉节奏宜接近。","权重也是数值列，但内容较短，可比目标值和实际值窄。","考核指标是行标题，文字明显更长，需要承担主要的换行。"],"keep_intact":["百分比、金额及其他数值连同单位和符号尽量保持在同一行。","列标题保持完整，尤其是目标值和实际值。"],"may_wrap":["考核指标可在中文词语或括号附近自然换行；较长指标形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [250, 57, 75, 75] · table 458×250px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [252, 57, 74, 74] · table 458×250px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [251, 57, 74, 75] · table 458×250px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"指标列获得主要空间；权重、目标值和实际值均保持完整，目标与实际两列等宽，便于逐行比较。两条较长指标各占两行，其他行保持紧凑。","problems":"前两条指标的末尾落到第二行，第一条只剩“议）”，第二条只剩“加权）”，换行显得零碎。","cause":"指标列为250px，可用文字宽度为229px，容不下完整指标；要在不压缩数值列的前提下解决这种短尾换行，剩余空间不足。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"指标列比r2A略宽，目标与实际两列等宽，表头均完整。","problems":"第一条实际值的“亿”被挤到下一行，破坏数值与单位的连续性；指标列增加的空间也未消除两条长指标的短尾换行。","cause":"实际值列为74px，可用文字宽度仅53px，小于该列最长单行内容所需的54px；指标列增加至252px仍不足以容纳完整长指标。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"实际值列比r2B多1px，使数值与单位保持完整；目标值列也恰好容纳单行内容。两列宽度仅差1px，比较节奏协调，表头完整。","problems":"前两条长指标仍有零碎的第二行，尤其第一条只剩“议）”。","cause":"指标列为251px，可用文字宽度为230px；其余三列已分别接近保持内容完整所需的最小宽度，无法再腾出足够空间消除短尾换行。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
